description-aboutUs: We are the Viet Vibe Foundation, a vibrant non-profit organization dedicated to fostering vibrancy, creativity, and building connections within the Vietnamese community in Vancouver. With the enthusiasm and passion of our members, we aim to bring people together through the universal languages of sports, music, and other activities.
musicDescription-aboutUs: With professional performers who have experience in a wide range of instruments and skills (guitar, piano, drum, dance, etc.), our music lessons and workshops offer participants the opportunity to learn, grow, and connect with the art of music in a connecting and inspiring environment.
sportDescription-aboutUs: From exciting competitions to hands-on skill-building sessions, we invite everyone to join in - regardless of age or experience. Have fun, improve your skills, connect with others, and enjoy being part of a welcoming, vibrant, and inclusive community of sports lovers.
volunteerDescription-aboutUs: We believe everyone deserves the chance to participate in activities and events that help them grow and build strong connections. We warmly welcome new members to join us and make meaningful contributions to the Vietnamese as well as all our global friends in Vancouver.
